source: PixelLab create_image_pixen, 64 x 64, no background, seeds 1201-1203; cut, cleaned and flattened by tools/art-import/glyph_tiles.py
prompt: A sheet of sixteen small magical rune glyphs arranged in an even 4 by 4 grid, one rune centred in each cell with clear space around it. Each rune is a simple angular sigil of thin strokes, like ancient carved runes: lines, hooks, small circles and chevrons, every one different. Pure white strokes with soft light grey edges on a transparent background, flat, crisp pixel art.
